correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and boundaries are in RESULT.md. Firm-resolvent inner-product inequality yields the exact universal transfer upper envelope. Two-stage decomposition and the positive 2x2 gain produce an exact determinant test. An alpha choice with L(3-2/(1+alpha muA))<muA muB makes a common positive Perron-type weight for all theta in [0,1] and arbitrary switching. Scalar H=-L I gives det(I-T)=alpha beta q s(muA muB-L), proving no class-level strict contraction at or below equality. A standalone checker returned 8,737 diagnostic groups; universality is analytic, not inferred from tests.
